product.name: Boombah Men's Custom Shoes
product.description: Introducing the customizable Boombah Viper cleat. Crafted with a sublimated fabric vamp, our cleat boasts vibrant, fade-resistant prints that reflect your unique personality and team spirit. With 13 distinct areas for customization, including player names and numbers, you have the power to tailor every detail to your preference. Plus, with an industry-leading lead time, you'll be geared up faster than ever before.
product.leadTime: Ships in 2 weeks. Please Note: There will be no mockup when ordering these shoes if a custom logo is not used.
